cost_uninitialized.label: No confirmed cost basis yet
cost_uninitialized.explanation: The value appears once the underlying costs are confirmed and a company owner has approved the review.

cost_pending.label: Cost basis is incomplete
cost_pending.explanation: Some evidence or a confirmation is still missing. The steps below show what is open.

cost_stale.label: Newer business activity since the last confirmation
cost_stale.explanation: The last confirmed value is shown for reference only until the review is renewed.

cost_failed.label: The last cost preparation could not be used
cost_failed.explanation: Inspect the evidence of the last preparation and prepare it again.

cost_complete.label: Cost basis is confirmed and current
cost_complete.explanation: The value is based on the confirmed review for this scope.

inventory_scope_not_reviewed.label: Nobody has confirmed the acquisition cost for this item yet
inventory_scope_not_reviewed.explanation: Stock value appears once every receipt carries confirmed cost and a company owner has confirmed the item's cost review.

inventory_review_stale.label: The item's cost review is out of date
inventory_review_stale.explanation: Stock movements or cost evidence changed after the last confirmation. The review needs to be renewed.

commercial_match_not_reviewed.label: Revenue and goods cost have not been confirmed together
commercial_match_not_reviewed.explanation: DB1 appears once the invoice line, its shipment and the item's confirmed cost are reviewed as one contribution.

contribution_profile_not_reviewed.label: The contribution method has not been confirmed
contribution_profile_not_reviewed.explanation: The contribution review confirms which method applies to this invoice line.

selling_costs_unknown.label: Selling costs are not known yet
selling_costs_unknown.explanation: DB2 needs the direct and allocated selling costs, such as freight or fees, to be assigned and reviewed. DB1 does not depend on them.

selling_category.label: A selling cost category is still open
selling_category.explanation: One category of selling costs has not been reviewed. DB2 stays unknown until it is.

contribution_review_stale.label: The contribution review is out of date
contribution_review_stale.explanation: Newer evidence exists for this invoice line. The contribution review needs to be renewed.

received_net_missing.label: The invoice line has no stated net amount
received_net_missing.explanation: Reality records amounts as the source states them and never computes them. The source must supply the net amount.

billed_order_line_missing.label: The invoice line is not linked to an order line
billed_order_line_missing.explanation: A contribution needs to know which order line was billed. The link must come from the source or the invoice entry.

consumption_not_reviewed.label: The shipment's goods cost is not confirmed
consumption_not_reviewed.explanation: The item's cost review does not yet cover this shipment. Renew the item's cost review.

consumption_after_cutoff.label: The shipment happened after the last cost confirmation
consumption_after_cutoff.explanation: Renew the item's cost review so it includes this shipment.

unsupported_revenue_type.label: This line type has no contribution
unsupported_revenue_type.explanation: Contributions are calculated for item lines of sales invoices only.

unsupported_order_scope.label: The billed line is not a sales order item
unsupported_order_scope.explanation: Contributions are calculated for invoice lines that bill a sales order item.

corrected_fulfilment_unsupported.label: The shipment was corrected
corrected_fulfilment_unsupported.explanation: Contributions for corrected shipments are not supported yet.

negative_revenue_requires_match.label: Negative revenue needs a matching credit
negative_revenue_requires_match.explanation: A negative invoice amount can only be reviewed against the credit it belongs to.

owner_scope_mismatch.label: Stock owner and seller differ
owner_scope_mismatch.explanation: The confirmed stock belongs to a different party than the one that sold it.

currency_scope_mismatch.label: Invoice and cost use different currencies
currency_scope_mismatch.explanation: The item's confirmed cost is in a different currency than the invoice.

unit_scope_mismatch.label: Invoice and cost use different units
unit_scope_mismatch.explanation: The item's confirmed cost uses a different unit than the invoice line.

quantity_scope_mismatch.label: Invoiced and shipped quantities differ
quantity_scope_mismatch.explanation: The invoice line and the confirmed shipment cost cover different quantities.

not_admitted.label: No cost has been assigned to this receipt
not_admitted.explanation: Assign the supplier invoice lines that belong to this receipt.

no_attributed_cost.label: No cost is attributed to this receipt
no_attributed_cost.explanation: Assign the supplier invoice lines that belong to this receipt.

scope_not_reviewed.label: The receipt's cost has not been reviewed
scope_not_reviewed.explanation: Review the assigned costs of this receipt.

review_stale.label: The receipt's cost review is out of date
review_stale.explanation: Cost evidence changed after the review. Review the receipt again.

review_categories_incomplete.label: Not every cost category of the receipt is reviewed
review_categories_incomplete.explanation: Each category, such as goods or inbound freight, needs a decision.

category.label: A cost category of the receipt is still open
category.explanation: Decide whether this category applies and confirm its evidence.

tax_basis_incomplete.label: The tax basis of the cost evidence is incomplete
tax_basis_incomplete.explanation: The supplier invoice must state whether its amounts include tax.

receipt_corrected.label: The receipt was corrected
receipt_corrected.explanation: Review the cost of the corrected receipt.

assessment_missing.label: No carrying value assessment exists
assessment_missing.explanation: A carrying value needs a confirmed valuation assessment for this item.

assessment_not_supported.label: Carrying value is not assessed for this item
assessment_not_supported.explanation: Only the acquisition value is available for this item.

projection_uninitialized.label: Waiting for the first calculation
projection_uninitialized.explanation: Calculations run in the background. They start once background processing is running.

projection_pending.label: A newer calculation is on its way
projection_pending.explanation: The last completed result is shown until the background calculation finishes.

projection_failed.label: The last calculation failed
projection_failed.explanation: The last completed result is shown. The operator can see the cause in the system status.

handler_timeout.label: The calculation took too long
handler_timeout.explanation: It will be retried automatically. Large companies may need more processing time.

handler_failed.label: The calculation stopped with an error
handler_failed.explanation: The operator can see the cause in the system status.

database_error.label: The database was not reachable during the calculation
database_error.explanation: It will be retried automatically once the database is reachable again.

child_exited.label: Background processing stopped during the calculation
child_exited.explanation: It will be retried automatically once background processing runs again.

outcome_unresolved.label: It is unclear whether the last calculation finished
outcome_unresolved.explanation: The operator needs to check the calculation in the system status.

no_applicable_price.label: No price applies to this business partner and item
no_applicable_price.explanation: Price lists and their assignments are maintained by an administrator.

inventory_valuation_unavailable.label: No company valuation has been published yet
inventory_valuation_unavailable.explanation: Company valuations are built in the background by the operator once item cost reviews exist.

no_import_job.label: No import has run for this source
no_import_job.explanation: Set up the source so its records can be imported.

insufficient_stock.label: Not enough stock
insufficient_stock.explanation: Record the incoming goods or wait for the next receipt.

insufficient_reservation.label: Not enough stock reserved
insufficient_reservation.explanation: Reserve available stock for this order.

prepayment_required.label: Prepayment required
prepayment_required.explanation: This order ships only after the prepayment is invoiced and paid.

prepayment_invoice_missing.label: Prepayment invoice missing
prepayment_invoice_missing.explanation: Record the prepayment invoice for this order.

prepayment_attribution_ambiguous.label: Prepayment cannot be matched clearly
prepayment_attribution_ambiguous.explanation: More than one invoice or payment could belong to this order. Check the open items.

commitment_hold.label: The order is on hold
commitment_hold.explanation: Release the hold when the order may ship.

party_delivery_hold.label: The customer is on delivery hold
party_delivery_hold.explanation: Release the customer's delivery hold when shipping may resume.

receipt_cost_evidence.label: Confirm the cost of each receipt
receipt_cost_evidence.chat_prompt: Prepare the receipt cost review for {scope}: assign the supplier invoice lines to each open receipt and review its cost categories.

inventory_review.label: Prepare the item's cost review
inventory_review.chat_prompt: Prepare the inventory cost review for {scope} so a company owner can confirm it.

inventory_review_renew.label: Renew the item's cost review
inventory_review_renew.chat_prompt: Renew the inventory cost review for {scope} with the current evidence so a company owner can confirm it.

contribution_review.label: Prepare the contribution review
contribution_review.chat_prompt: Prepare the contribution review for {scope} so a company owner can confirm it.

selling_cost_review.label: Review the selling costs
selling_cost_review.chat_prompt: Prepare the selling cost review for {scope}: assign freight, fees and other selling costs and review each category.

owner_confirmation.label: A company owner confirms the proposal

source_data_limit.label: The source data does not allow this yet
